name: God Helmet: modulated 40 Hz both sides, then amygdala left (40 min)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva God Helmet software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: Todd Murphy's two-phase Shiva God Helmet session: the 'modulated 40 Hz' (binding factor) signal over both temporal lobes, then the amygdala burst-firing signal over the left temporal lobe. The vendor states it works like the chirp version (presence, elation, joy, imagery) but is 'more likely to elicit psychic phenomena' as an undertone; 40-minute version.
notes: 40-minute version (20 + 20 min, switching abruptly); the vendor also offers a 60-minute version (murphy-gh-mod40bi-amyl-60min). Four coils per temporal lobe in a cross centred near T7/T8 (an inference from 'four coils over each temporal lobe'); the field steps from coil to coil, 'clockwise over the left side, counter-clockwise over the right' as the vendor states, read with each side seen from its own side, so both sides step top, back, bottom, front (C5-TP7-T9-FT7 and C6-TP8-T10-FT8; an inference). An image caption on the vendor's session list says the signals cycle clockwise on the right side, which contradicts the text; this preset follows the text. The step time is unpublished (Murphy: one cycle takes 'a fraction of a second'), so 125 ms per coil (0.5 s per cycle) is used. The 'modulated 40 Hz' file is proprietary; the vendor calls it a signal 'almost in sync with the brain's own binding factor, but not quite' and, on its Shakti pages, a 'constant tone'. It is approximated by a continuous 40 Hz carrier whose phase swings up to 3 rad ahead of and behind a steady 40 Hz every 2 s (38.5-41.5 Hz). The amygdala 'burstx' file is proprietary; it is approximated by the built-in accelerating burst (6 to 30 Hz) with 230 points, the point count of the published lab burst-firing pattern (which used 4-ms points; Ryczko & Persinger 2002), on the vendor's standard 3-ms points, so 0.69 s, close to the 'about 0.7 s' bursts Persinger's lab reported at 1 µT (Persinger, Hoang & Baker-Price 2009); then the 4-s silence: about 9 s of field per minute (the vendor states 9.6 s). 1 µT follows Persinger's papers, which mostly report about 1 µT (10 mG), and the vendor's '10mG' calibration for the modulated 40 Hz signal; the vendor's other figures disagree (10-20 mG on one page, a 50 or 90 mG 'laboratory standard' on others). The vendor marks this session experimental: if anger appears during or after it, never reuse it. Not for people prone to anger. Vendor exclusions: epilepsy or seizure history, psychiatric conditions or medication, migraine, brain injury, drugs. Stop on any distress. Independent double-blind tests found no effect of the fields (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012).
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence (the vendor: 'silence, not just quiet'), blindfold or eyes closed; sit or lie relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. The vendor prefers night sessions on geomagnetically quiet days and a helper who can stop the session. No meditation, mind machines or drugs at the same time.
schedule: Vendor rules: at most weekly, never on consecutive days; a series of up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break; not mixed with Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks; try a session 2-3 times before changing it.
